subject: Tatjana Smith heads to the Netherlands
preheader: Plus Bolles keeps its dynasty alive and a coach needs the swim community's support.
heroHeading: Good morning swimmers and happy Monday
heroTeaser: Tatjana Smith is switching flags to the Netherlands, and the story of how that split happened is messier than you might expect.
outroLine: That's the week in the water. Happy swimming,

workout.dateLabel: Mon, Nov 16 · Distance freestyle in the pool, core and stability on land

swimSet.title: Today's Swim Set
swimSet.description: Long aerobic freestyle repeats designed to build your engine -- the goal is holding clean form and a consistent stroke count all the way through, even when fatigue sets in.

lift.title: Today's Lift
lift.description: An anti-rotation stability and rotational power session targeting the core patterns that drive freestyle and backstroke -- exactly the foundation that pays off in the water on a heavy aerobic week.

newsItems.title: Swimming SA puts its side of the Tatjana story on the record
newsItems.body: Swimming SA operations manager Mafata Modutoane has gone public with the federation's account of its breakup with Tatjana Smith, centering on Smith wearing Speedo at the 2023 World Championships instead of the team-mandated Arena kit. Whether you sympathize with the athlete or the federation, it is a rare and candid look at how these sponsor disputes can quietly fracture a national team relationship.

newsItems.title: Bolles just keeps winning -- 39 boys titles in a row
newsItems.body: The Bolles School boys captured their 39th consecutive Florida 1A state championship, while the girls added their 36th straight title. Both teams won in dominant fashion, cementing a dynasty that has simply no comparison in American high school swimming.

newsItems.title: Abi Burke breaks a 10-year-old Florida state meet record
newsItems.body: Abi Burke of Barron Collier set a Florida 2A state meet record in the 200 freestyle, breaking a mark that had stood since 2016 when Morgan Tankersley swam it at Tampa Plant. Burke is currently ranked number one in the country for 15-16 girls in both the 100 and 200 free, and she led Barron Collier to the team title in the process.

newsItems.title: A coach and his family need the community right now
newsItems.body: Mavi Sampaio, head coach of Palm Desert Swim Club, and his wife Ana "Tuca" Sampaio, a swim instructor, were both seriously injured in a head-on collision last Monday. If your club or team has a moment to reach out or support this family, now is the time.

athlete.name: Hubert Kos
athlete.photoCredit: Photo: Tanis Coralee Leonhardi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
athlete.bio:
Hubert Kos is a Hungarian swimmer born on 28 March 2003 and a member of the University of Texas swim team. He has family connections to Ireland through his paternal grandmother and spent time in Cork as a child. He studied at the American International School of Budapest and has two younger siblings, Olivér and Alison, who are also swimmers.

Kos holds a world junior record in the 200 metre individual medley. He won bronze at the 2021 European Short Course Championships in the 400 metre individual medley, gold at the 2022 European Aquatics Championships in the 200 metre individual medley, bronze at the 2023 NCAA Division I Championships in the 200 yard backstroke, and gold in the 200 metre backstroke at the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris.
